acceptanceCriteria: Read each of the 21 current pinned reference test paths listed in scope and record an evidence-backed Rust semantic counterpart or an explicit non-portable boundary.
Update the machine inventory only for these paths to the batch classification with per-file counterpart/boundary reasons; do not classify retired or unreviewed paths.
Add synchronized English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese comparison documentation and parity registration describing the per-file decisions and object/adopter inheritance boundary.
Run reference inventory, documentation, parity, CI gate, and workspace tests; no source Python, Make, provider-global configuration, or source JSON wire format is copied.
goal: Compare the next bounded set of current reference test responsibilities file by file and register only evidence-backed Rust semantic parity.
intent: Prevent omissions in the reference comparison by reconciling adoption, enterprise evidence, lifecycle readiness, governance guards, hosted verification, and input-trust responsibilities with the installed Rust Runtime and its adopter boundary.
outOfScope: Changing Rust runtime behavior unless a concrete migrate-gap is found and the Contract is amended before implementation.
Copying Python scripts, Make targets, provider-global configuration, source generated history, or source JSON wire schemas.
Classifying retired reference paths or the remaining deferred tests not listed in this Contract.
Operating or modifying any external adopter repository.
